notes: Issue body verbatim confirms the wrong dump output and the reproducer; maintainer comment 1933083033 verbatim confirms the cause and the two-part fix. class representation_convention is correct: the mismatch is how an uninitialized parameter is encoded in the GetParameters response (empty array vs per-name PARAMETER_NOT_SET entries of the same length), rather than a type or name mismatch. outcome failure (wrong output), loudness silent_documented (dump completes with wrong values and no diagnostic, detection_stage run) are correct. Resolution recommended is correct: both PRs (rclpy#1216, ros2cli#881) merged on rolling 2024-02-09 but no fixed-composition output is shown, and the rclpy fix was not backported to the reporter's iron install.
